craft_notes: Sthāyin: question-tension (vīra waking). Sanskrit first: katham...gamyate → L4 keeps the how, answers with method, dash seals alone-ness. Rows: row 3 (how/if frame). Rupture: dash after alone? No — question line 1, answer line 2, dash inside answer. Close: end-weight on soleness. Minimal pass: 'If won at all' for yadi kenacit (anyone-at-all sung). Read aloud: question rises, answer settles. Rejected: 'ineffable' — killed: undescribed is apophatic act, ineffable is aesthetic; 'discover' for gamyate — killed: reached kept (passive arrival).

lines: How speak a thing no sign can show? If won at all,
it is won by feeling self — by that method alone.
l4.sanskrit_cite: vyapadeśavihīnasya tattvasya kathanaṃ katham / svasaṃvedanasadyuktyā gamyate yadi kenacit

reads_against.argmap: The undescribable is reached, if at all, by the true method of self-feeling.
c1_essence: Undesignated reality: spoken only by self-feeling's true method.
